title: Automations: when the daily limit is reached

steps.path: Pages → Automations → a card with a Runs per day limit
steps.headline: At its daily limit, Run now greys out and says why.
steps.changed: Where Run now sits, the button reads Daily limit reached, with the count and that it can run again tomorrow. The same rule covers every way of starting it: the page's own button greys out too.
steps.notice: To run it anyway, raise the number under Runs per day in the same popup. There is no separate override, so the limit means one thing everywhere.
